ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on distal lobes. Dense black speckling and mottling concentrated near the peduncle and trailing edges. A distinct dark circular annulus is positioned in the medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern along the entire horizontal boundary, with primary jagged peaks on the left lobe and smaller rhythmic valleys on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the leading edges, tapering to sharp, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible circular high-contrast ring-like mark on the right lobe. Clustered white-to-tan calcified protrusions (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent, high-intensity white vertical linear mark on the right lobe, intersecting the dark pigment boundary; several smaller parallel faint white scratches on the left lobe medial area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Permanent irregular notches along the trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy barnacle encrustation on the fluke tips.
